subject: Urgent: mid-cycle credit watch — multi-entity invoice & VAT routing mismatch
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: AR Team <accounts@nimble-retail.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Outstanding invoices + VAT entity clarification (INV-2934 / INV-2879)

Hi Lisa / Nimble AR,

Following up on INV-2934 (due 2028-06-30) and INV-2879 (overdue). Our payments team flagged that the remit entity you provided references your US purchasing entity but the invoice was issued by our UK subsidiary — this has triggered a VAT remittance question on your side.

Can you confirm: which legal entity is processing payment for these invoices? If your treasury is paying from Nimble Retail Ltd (EU), we can reissue with the matching entity details; if payment will come from the US entity, we need your EU VAT certificate so we can advise on reverse-charge handling.

I attached copies of the two invoices and the VAT file we received earlier for quick reference.

Next steps I propose:
- Please confirm remit entity and expected payment date by EOD 2028-06-22.
- If you need reissued invoices, tell us the legal name and VAT number for the EU entity.

If we don’t hear back, we’ll move to a short-term credit watch and flag the account for limited provisioning in coordination with CS. Not ideal — wanted to surface early so we can avoid service disruption.

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Accounts Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: INV-2028-06-17-REDWOOD-2934.pdf, INV-2028-05-02-REDWOOD-2879.pdf, VAT_certificate_Nimble_EU.pdf

From: Lisa Moreno <lisa.moreno@nimble-retail.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: AR Team <accounts@nimble-retail.com>
Date: 2028-06-22T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Outstanding invoices + VAT entity clarification (INV-2934 / INV-2879)

Hi Marcus — thanks for flagging.

Quick answers: our AP team intends to pay using Nimble Holdings Inc (US) for this quarter due to centralized treasury timing. We have EU entity Nimble Retail Ltd but the payment run is from the US. We have attached the EU VAT certificate but the US payment will require your team to confirm whether you can accept the US remit and whether we need a reissued invoice showing Nimble Holdings Inc as payer for internal tracking.

We expect funds to be released in the next payment run on 2028-06-28, but I wanted to be transparent about the entity mismatch. Please advise whether reissue is required or if we can proceed with the US remit and send proof of payment once processed.

Best,
Lisa
VP Finance, Nimble Retail

Attachment: VAT_certificate_Nimble_EU.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-28T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Outstanding invoices + VAT entity clarification — recommend short credit watch

Kimberly / Markus — looping you in. Nimble says payment will originate from Nimble Holdings Inc (US) but can share EU VAT certificate. They expect to pay 2028-06-28 payment run but we have two outstanding items and one is already past due.

My recommendation: place the account on a 7-day credit watch (no service cutoff yet) while we await proof of payment. If no payment confirmation by 2028-07-06, escalate to a 14-day restricted provisioning (reduce rate-limits / disable non-essential integrations).

Notes for decision:
- We can reissue an invoice showing their US remit but that delays collection and creates reconciliation overhead.
- Legal (Markus) — if payment comes from the US entity, do we need a reissued invoice for VAT treatment or is the EU VAT certificate sufficient to record reverse charge?

Please advise a firm cadence and whether to involve CS for messaging to product teams.

Thanks,
Marcus

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-04T14:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Outstanding invoices + VAT entity clarification — recommend short credit watch

Marcus — thanks for the summary and for nudging. Approved: implement a 7-day credit watch effective immediately (2028-07-04 through 2028-07-11). Ask CS to prepare a soft-notice template (no service disruption wording) so they can reach the customer if proof of payment is not posted.

Operational steps for AR Ops:
- Mark account: CreditWatch (7 days) and set follow-up reminder 2028-07-08.
- If payment confirmation not received by 2028-07-11, move to Restricted Provisioning (rate-limit and pause premium features).
- Do not reissue invoice unless Nimble requests it formally — instead accept US remit if they provide bank remittance and EU VAT certificate for our tax records. Markus, confirm whether our VAT recording requires a reissue in this scenario; if so, let me know asap.

Evelyn — please draft the communication for CS to send (short, friendly, explains next steps and technical impact) and cc me. Marcus, keep me posted on receipt of proof of payment.

Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

On legal: Markus replied in-line earlier that the EU VAT certificate should be sufficient to record a reverse-charge and a reissued invoice is not required from a VAT compliance perspective — only for the customer’s internal audit trail. He will confirm by EOD if any additional documentation should be logged in our tax folder.
